summary: Resolve race conditions in artwork transitions, prevent memory leaks during playback, and synchronize auto-advance timers with manual navigation.

items.issue: Race condition in ArtBackdrop settle timer allows incorrect images to become the base layer during rapid switching.
items.evidence: src/art/ArtBackdrop.tsx: setTimeout(() => dispatch({ type: 'settle', id }), 2400) is not tied to the current artwork prop.
items.change: Update the settle useEffect to include 'artwork.id' in the dependency array and ensure the cleanup function clears the timeout.
items.check: Rapidly switch artworks and verify the final displayed image matches the selected artwork ID.

items.issue: Accumulation of ArtScene components and image buffers during 'Play collection' sessions.
items.evidence: src/art/ArtBackdrop.tsx: Maps over [state.base, state.incoming] without a mechanism to purge the base layer after settling.
items.change: Modify the artTransition reducer to explicitly nullify the previous base layer once the incoming artwork is settled.
items.check: Inspect DOM during playback to ensure only the active ArtScene remains after transition completion.

items.issue: Manual navigation in ArtViewer conflicts with the auto-advance interval, causing potential double-skips.
items.evidence: src/art/ArtViewer.tsx: move() resets elapsed.current but does not clear or reset the active setInterval.
items.change: Wrap the auto-advance logic in a useEffect that depends on selected.id, effectively resetting the interval on every manual move.
items.check: Click 'Next' rapidly and verify the auto-advance timer restarts from zero for each new artwork.
